shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Four vanilla-matched per-level sizes (126/190/250/300) and level counts are bought from a fixed 192,000-cell budget. Per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine. Content on lower levels draws smaller once per level of drop, which is what makes a deep column read as depth.
body:
> **NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §1-19 architecture; §20 compat library; §21-23 open items. Keep every ⚠ - each cost a run to learn.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. ~72 files, ~20,500 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

## Pitch
Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

## Status
Visuality, QOL, altitude/weather, settings VERIFIED IN PLAY. **#231: the 250 tier VERIFIED** - `map (250,1,768), bands=3, slot=256`, exactly 192,000 cells.
UNVERIFIED: below-snow, depth shrink (§6g), camera anchor (§8a), §18 audit, reroll grid, VEE compat, GL roof fix, tiers 126/190/300.

**PUBLISHED-BUILD BUGS.**
1. Preview only worked at 190x190 - **FIXED** (§6d-CLAMP).
2. Fog/rocks regenerate on save reload - **NOT DIAGNOSED, HELD** (§21).
3. GL + rivers - **TABLED** (§22). ⚠ Tabled with a CONTRADICTION outstanding, not resolved.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount * Slot)`. Bands stack along +z from the deepest basement, gutter between. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + MinGutter)/64)*64`; **64-alignment of SLOT is load-bearing** (terrain shaders sample by world position).

**The one insight.** `Region.Neighbors` is *topological, not spatial*. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms, temperature or vacuum, and `Reachability.CanReach` works unpatched. But reachability is not a path: 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

**Hard 1.6 constraints.** Path grid is IJobParallelFor over EVERY cell, so total stacked cells is the runtime metric. No `PathFinder.FindPath`. `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

**⚠ The stack is 2x to 7x anisotropic.** Anything vanilla normalises by BOTH dimensions is distorted - a bug class that cannot appear on a square map.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, seven shapes
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Anchor, a fraction of `Size.z` | river/lake centre; random/edge cell (§15a); VEE Crater jitter | remap the point |
| Field, a gradient on map centre | coastline (§6e); VEE LoneIsland and Crater | re-centre the sample coordinate |
| Noise space, a slice is not a short map | Map Preview (§6d); GL landform grids (§22) | generate at full height, then crop |
| Distance-to-extent, a margin off `Size` | `CloseToEdge`, no-build edge; river WIDTH | re-base onto the cell's band rect |
| **Aspect ratio, normalised by BOTH dims** | preview window and reroll grid (§6d) | lay out from the BAND, generate at the STACK |
| **Map-wide scalar** | snow melt (§7), temperature readout (§16), GL roof sweep | rewrite it per cell at the consumer |
| **Foreign absolute writes** (§22) | GL landform output lands in band 0, then our carve overwrites it | ORDER, not arithmetic - see §22 |

Still unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley (all `FalloffAtAngle`).
**`ABBandLocal.cs` is THE canonical FIELD rewrite** plus `BandLocalModule`, a `ModuleBase` wrapper for direct noise samplers.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN, budget 192,000 cells
**⚠ THE 64 CONSTRAINT IS ON *SLOT*, NOT BAND HEIGHT.** The original tiers were all 64k-2 - the tightest fit - and **that coincidence was mistaken for the requirement for months**.

| size | slot | gutter | cells/band | playable | max levels | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 126 | 128 | 2 | 16,128 | 98.4% | 7 (cap) | 112,896 |
| 190 | 192 | 2 | 36,480 | 99.0% | 5 | 182,400 |
| **250** | 256 | 6 | 64,000 | 97.7% | 3 | **192,000** ✅ VERIFIED #231 |
| **300** | 320 | 20 | 96,000 | 93.8% | 2 | **192,000** |

250/300 are vanilla's Medium and Large exactly. **Budget is tuned:** 192,000 = `3 x 64,000` = `2 x 96,000`; `6 x 190`, `4 x 250`, `3 x 300` refused. Ladder 7/5/3/2, every tier yields real z-levels - which is why 350/382 are not offered.
**⚠ 200 IS THE ONE NUMBER TO AVOID** - just past the 192 boundary: slot 256, gutter 56, 21.9% wasted. **Waste is a SAWTOOTH.**
**⚠ A WIDE GUTTER IS A FEATURE** - "a spatial helper that reaches 22 rows will cross a 2-row gutter" is the root of §15a and §4.
**Old saves are safe** - `bandHeight` is scribed per map; `SlotFor` is generic. Per-level size is SQUARE, so `CountFromPer10kCells` yields a per-BAND count. **`Size.x == bandHeight` is a repair tool.**
**⚠ THE PLAN PERSISTS BETWEEN COLONIES AND SILENTLY CONSTRAINS THE SIZE.** #231's first map was `7 x 126 | 3 up / 3 down` when 250/3 was intended - correct behaviour (250 at 7 levels costs 448,000), but **levels must be reduced BEFORE the larger size is selectable.** Read the PLAN line before believing any size test.
**⚠ Own the widget, do not patch the data.** `MapSizes` is `static readonly` and the reflection swap SILENTLY FAILED. Our radio buttons write `GameInitData.mapSize` directly - **the authoritative record of the choice.** **Adding a tier means growing the `InitialSize` postfix** (now +288f). **The chooser LATCHES global state, released in a `Finalizer`.**

# 3-5. MOVEMENT, ORDERING, DESCENT
**Cross-band movement** segmented at ONE interception: `StartPath` prefix, tick sweep, `Carry` re-issues. Hops must strictly decrease. **Multi-hop UNTESTED IN PLAY.**
**Group ordering:** the drag line between bands runs through the GUTTER; the odd/even signature ("3 and 5 fail, 2 and 4 do not") is the proof - only ODD counts sample exactly 0.5.
**⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE: `TryResolveVisibleBelow`.** TEN systems share it; **EIGHT appearances of the single `- Slot` bug** (the eighth as INDEX arithmetic, invisible to the standing `grep '- Slot'` audit). **`TryResolveVisibleFrom` is THE gate.** Exceptions: `SectionLayer_ABBelowV2` needs "in bounds but fogged"; upward-shape consumers ask a different question.

# 6. SKY-MASS PRESENTATION (verified)
Despeckle (walls dissolve only at 7+ open neighbours; at 6 it ate the outermost wall row off every meadow edge), central fog hole, five-terrain plateau palette, cliff faces, alpine pass.
**⚠ The mass tapers with altitude, so +3 may contain NO LAND AT ALL.**
Ore glyph bug: ore defs have no `naturalTerrain`, so a "can't happen" fallback drew the whole atlas sheet per cell.

# 6a. ⚠ THE BELOW VIEW IS MIRRORED PASSES, NOT ONE RENDERER
`SectionLayer_ABBelowV2` ports vanilla `SectionLayer_Terrain` **and nothing else**. Confirmed twice: Water (§6b), Snow (§6f).
**⚠ THE CONVERSE IS HANDLED.** A foreign `Thing.Print` postfix prints into OUR layer and is still correct, because the call is bracketed `SnapshotVertCounts()` -> `Print` -> `FinishNewVerts`, and **`FinishNewVerts` transforms by VERTEX RANGE, not by knowing which graphic emitted what.** Preserve that - it is why third-party graphics work for free (§23).
**Multi-cell things:** `IsPrintAnchor` walks `OccupiedRect` and prints ONCE at the first cell that shows below, so a 2x2 does not print four times.
**Ascent rule:** the dirty mirror stops at the first opaque floor, tested over the cell and its eight neighbours; the FIRST step stays unconditional (MountainCap). Mirrors vanilla's `ProgramState` guard.
**⚠ THE UNIT OF WASTE IS A SECTION REGENERATION, NOT A CELL.**

# 6b. ⚠ WATER: a TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE effect
The visible `Map/TerrainWater` samples the WaterDepth subcamera's texture at its own SCREEN position; `SectionLayer_ABBelowWatergen` targets `SubcameraDefOf.WaterDepth.LayerId`. Rivers: remap `GetRiverCenter` (not `Init`, which consumes it immediately); `GetLakeCenter` needs the same or it undoes the first. Width clamped at the producer.
**⚠ ALL THREE ARE INERT UNDER GL** (`riverGraph: 0 node(s)`), §22.

# 6c. DUBS MINT MINIMAP (verified)
ONE RECT. `DrawTextureFitted` preserves the TEXTURE's aspect, so use `ScaleMode.StretchToFill`.

# 6d. MAP PREVIEW
Builds a bare Map on a background thread, so our banding prefix never fires. **Generate at full stacked height, crop via `TexCoords`.** `MaxMapSize.z` MUST rise.

## 6d-CLAMP. ⚠ PUBLISHED BUG: PREVIEW ONLY WORKED AT 190x190 (FIXED)
`Stacked()` ran the incoming size through `Clamp()`, which returns *the largest offered size ≤ input that fits at the current level count*. Map Preview passes VANILLA's size (250 default):
```
Clamp(250) at 4 levels -> 190  ->  lastBandHeight = 190
TryBandRows: BandCount * SlotFor(190) == stackedZ ?  only true if 190 was chosen
```
**Fix: `PlannedSize`.** `Clamp` is LOSSY by design and was answering "what did the player choose?" - never a derivation problem, since the chooser writes `mapSize` directly. Also fixed: `Stacked` clamped x and z INDEPENDENTLY though a band is square; `FixWindowAspect` re-Clamped.
**⚠ MAP PREVIEW SHIPS IN TWO HALVES, AND GL BUNDLES ONE.** Engine half byte-identical in both; `MapPreviewWindow`/`MapSeedRerollWindow` live ONLY in `MapPreviewMod.dll`. **With GL installed and Map Preview absent, `Active` is TRUE while window types are ABSENT.** Safe only because every target is null-guarded independently. **Do not "simplify" `Active`.**

## 6d-REROLL (UNVERIFIED)
**⚠ Opened COMPLETELY EMPTY:** `elementSize.y = 403/126*896 = 2,866 px` -> `gridSize.y = 0` -> `DesiredCount = 0`. **The SECOND consumer of the stacked size caught out by it.** Fixed by a postfix re-deriving from BAND height - repairing two statics, not reimplementing.

# 6e-6g. COASTS, SNOW, SHRINK
**Coasts:** CENTRED wrong, not scaled wrong. NO SCALING. **⚠ "None override `GetNoiseValue`" is about VANILLA ONLY.**
**Below-snow (UNVERIFIED):** no mirror of `SectionLayer_Snow` existed. Near-miss: `CellTerrainAt` samples `snowGrid.GetDepth(below)` correctly but it is consumed only by `MaterialFor` to pick the POLLUTED variant. Geometry built once (NOT `ClearSubMeshes(All)`); iteration order must match `MakeBaseGeometry`; empty cells still emit nine transparent vertices. **⚠ Queue-decided draw order may need work.**
**Depth shrink (UNVERIFIED):** exponent is the accumulated drop. **⚠ The atlas trap:** past `ZoomRootSize` 18 humanlikes render from a cached atlas blit ignoring `PawnDrawParms.matrix`; **verify across that boundary both ways.** Right-multiply the pawn matrix. **⚠ Exclusions kept verbatim:** LINKED graphics print one quad per cell; **natural rock excluded BY DEF (`mineable` / `isNaturalRock`), not by link type, because Better Mountains swaps rock to non-linked `Graphic_Random` wholesale (V1 run #50)** - see §23.
**⚠ PERSPECTIVE MODE WAS BUILT AND REMOVED. Do not re-add as polish.**

# 7-8a. CHARACTER, CAMERA
Ore `x(1+0.45*(depth-1))`, caves `x(1+0.35*(depth-1))`, after the clamp. **Ore scales `basementOreDensity` through our OWN `ABOreGen.ScatterOres`.** **⚠ The snow line never worked, and the comment saying it did not need to was wrong.**
**The camera clamp and level-switch input share `ABGuard.Camera`**, both per-frame paths where an unthrottled `Log.Error` turns a cosmetic bug into a hang.
**New-game anchor:** two things move the colony AFTER `PlayerStartSpot` - `RescueStrandedColonists` and the carve. **Only `StartedNewGame` runs after vanilla's own camera jump.** ⚠ OPEN: `z=24` was EXACTLY `PodScatterMargin`.

# 9. GENERATION COST

## 9a. The profile stamps its own conditions
`ABGenProfile.Report` prints `TILE`, `PLAN`, `SCOPING:`, two censuses. Has voided or explained five comparisons.
**⚠ THE WATER REPORT DOES NOT AND SHOULD.** #231's water report answered for a map whose TILE, MUTATORS and PLAN it never printed. **Add TILE + mutators + PLAN + surfaceBand to `ABWaterBand.Report`.**

## 9b. ⚠ "COST IS DESTRUCTION NOT GENERATION" - NO LONGER TRUE, AND THE FIX IS WHY
#188: gensteps 3,972 ms / carve 20,447 ms / 74,584 destroyed (16/84).
**#231 INVERTS IT: gensteps 3,836 ms (71%) / carve 1,580 ms (29%) / 4,575 destroyed.** Rock suppression worked, so the carve got cheap and cost moved to generation. **16/84 is a historical record of a fixed problem, not a current fact.**

## 9c-9f. Rock, basement, baselines
#190 census: 43,517 rock SUPPRESSED vs 4,939 DESTROYED. `ABDoomedBands` suppresses `GenSpawn.Spawn(ThingDef,...)` in sky bands - safe by **shape**, **state-neutrality**, **sky only**.
Basement FillRock is the remaining carve cost (926 of 1,580 ms in #231). **⚠ My own §9d caution was falsified:** the basement keep hits only 14.4%; suppressing nets ~1.2 s.
**Sign flip, a confirmation not a bug:** with rock suppressed `Sky clear` INVERTED (rising with altitude) - rock tapers upward, so higher bands have more OPEN ground and chunks only grow on open ground.
**⚠ EVERY ABSOLUTE TIMING PREDATES THE TIER CHANGE.** 3 x 250 is 192,000 cells vs 7 x 126's 112,896 - 1.7x.

## 9g. ⚠ NEW #1 CANDIDATE: `GenStep_Plants` IN DOOMED BANDS
#231, `7 x 126` TropicalSwamp: **`GenStep - Plants 2270.1 ms` = 59% of ALL genstep time.** Six of seven bands doomed (95,256 of 112,896 cells), so **~84% is vegetation grown then erased**. Same shape §9d solves for rock.
**⚠ n=1, ON THE HIGHEST-PLANT-DENSITY BIOME IN THE GAME.** Mechanism tile-independent, magnitude not.
### Ranked
1. `GenStep_Plants` doomed-band suppression (~1.9 s on #231's tile).
2. Basement rock suppression (~1.2 s).
3. `GenStep_RockChunks` - `Filth_RubbleRock` top destroyed def in #231 (2,462 of 4,575).
4. Scattered ruins (also a CONTENT BUG - surface loses ruins vanilla intended).
5. `ABRockGen.PickIndex` Perlin precompute. NOT DONE: changes determinism.

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
59.6 fps at 96 pawns. **⚠ THAT BENCHMARK MEASURES THE WRONG THING** - cost is in section-regeneration BURSTS.
**⚠ Bisect toggles PERSIST across runs** (#172 opened with a stale `belowWater=False` mimicking a fixed bug). Now STAMPED INTO THE PROFILE.
**⚠ Poll the monitor even when nothing auto-prompts.**
**⚠ The pre-pinned palette always strips its LAST entry** - `EnsureAllNodesValid` walks BACKWARDS while `GetNode` lazily builds the graph. **n=4.** Keep padding with a DISTINCT throwaway.
**⚠ THE AUTO-PROMPT IS EDGE-TRIGGERED, SO CHECK THE COUNT, NOT THE TEXT.** A second water-report click produced no prompt; `monitor_get_error` returned the LATEST occurrence, which was still the FIRST - byte-identical and stale. **`count` is the only way to tell fresh from old.**
**⚠ Debug actions are `AllowedGameStates.PlayingOnMap`** - they silently do nothing on the world map / preview screen.

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **§23 renderer compat** - Better Trees is the real gap; BM and MO golem rocks already covered.
2. **§21 fog/rocks on reload** - the two-question observation.
3. **§9g plants** - confirm on a second biome, then implement.
4. Verify tiers 126/190/300; preview fix at 300.
5. Verify §18 audit, VEE compat, GL roof fix, reroll grid, depth shrink, camera anchor, below-snow.
6. Stamp TILE/PLAN into the water report.
7. Basement rock suppression; §9g 4-5; audit the other `FalloffAtAngle` mutators.
8. **Never exercised:** multi-hop stair router, elevator, basement PATHING/wormholes, cavern basement.
9. `ShotReport` drops target size. Biomes! at 40%. **Store page still says three levels.**
10. **§22 TABLED** - do not resume without re-reading the contradiction.

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove a subsystem innocent by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. Re-open a rejection only by naming the confound. Change one thing per experiment. Run the diagnostic before the third theory. A beautiful fit is not evidence.
**⚠ CHECK THAT YOUR CONFIGURATION CAN EXPRESS THE DIFFERENCE BEFORE RUNNING THE EXPERIMENT.** #231's water report was clean and **worthless as a discriminator**: with `surfaceBand = 0`, "the river lands in band 0" and "the river lands on the surface" are THE SAME SENTENCE. **Write down what each hypothesis predicts for THIS setup first; if they match, change the setup.**
**⚠ THE CONFIGURATION THAT HIDES A BUG IS OFTEN THE MECHANISM.** The same variable that made #231 undiscriminating (`surfaceBand`) is what decides whether band 0 is the surface or a doomed rock-filled band.
**⚠ Measure the ratio before optimising the half you assumed - and RE-measure after.** Generation was 16% and is now 71% *because the fix worked*. A ratio is a snapshot, not a property.
**⚠ Stamp the experiment's conditions into its own output** - and apply it to EVERY diagnostic, not just the one that taught you.
**⚠ THE SYMPTOM SET IS ITSELF EVIDENCE - ask what the affected things SHARE.** §21 named fog AND rocks and nothing else: exactly the two things stored as flat per-cell arrays sized by `map.Area`.
**⚠ CHECK THE OCCURRENCE COUNT BEFORE TRUSTING A RE-READ.**
**⚠ A LOSSY NORMALISER IS NOT A WAY TO READ A CHOICE.** When a function's contract is "snap to something valid", it can never RECOVER a value. Ask whether the answer is already recorded before computing it.
**⚠ A CONSTRAINT SATISFIED BY EVERY EXAMPLE IS NOT NECESSARILY THE CONSTRAINT.** All three original sizes were 64k-2; the real rule was only that *Slot* is 64-aligned. **Derive the constraint from the mechanism, not from what you already built.**
**⚠ THE REAL CONFLICT IS USUALLY A REPLACEMENT, NOT A COLLISION.** GL *substitutes its own worker*, so our patches never run - no error, no log line, no conflict warning. **Ask what a mod REPLACES, not only what it patches.**
**⚠ AND THE BUG AFTER THAT IS USUALLY A COLLABORATION.** §22 is not GL's fault or ours: GL writes to absolute map rows, our carve overwrites those rows. **Two locally-correct behaviours composing into a broken result. When neither side is wrong, look at the ORDER.**
**⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT IS ALREADY BUILT BEFORE BUILDING IT.** §23: two of three requested compat targets were already fully supported, one with the rationale documented against a numbered run. **A codebase this size has memory the author does not.** Grep the mod's NAME in your own source before writing a line.
**⚠ A SHARED METHOD NAME IS A HYPOTHESIS, NOT A CONFLICT.** Name-matching false-positive rate 50%; ReGrowth cleared four times.
**⚠ Compat work is mostly deletion.** **⚠ Design for the foreign patch you have not met.** **⚠ Waste is often a sawtooth.** **⚠ The thing you rounded away may be load-bearing.** **⚠ A rule enforced by grepping a SYNTAX only catches that syntax.** **⚠ Duplication is how an invariant dies.** **⚠ A comment is not an invariant.** **⚠ Steady-state fps hides burst cost.** **⚠ Timing that reads exactly 0.0 ms is an early return.** **⚠ In a foreign log, the loudest error is usually downstream.** **⚠ A finding scoped to vanilla does not transfer to mods.**
**Patching.** Re-aim the shared parameter. Find the ONE virtual everything funnels through - and when there is none, **wrap the DATA instead of the reader**. Patch the PRODUCER, not the store. Own the widget. Never put a foreign type in a patch signature - type `__instance` as `object`. **Suppress the callee, not the caller.** **Prefix state is released in a Finalizer.** **Repair a foreign method's output rather than reimplementing it.** **Never clamp a Def field to fix one map.** **Prefer a published ExtensionPoint over racing internals.** **Read the LIVE def field, never a baked copy, when a mod can rewrite it at runtime (§23).**
**Engine facts.** `holdSnowOrSand` defaults TRUE. Draw order is material render QUEUE, not altitude. `Banded` is FALSE for all of map generation. `SectionLayer` subclasses auto-discovered on EVERY map. FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread - generation latches must be `[ThreadStatic]`. Ore defs have no `naturalTerrain`. `CameraJumper.TryJump` and `MapDrawer.MapMeshDirty` return silently unless `ProgramState == Playing`. Humanlikes past `ZoomRootSize` 18 render from an atlas blit ignoring `PawnDrawParms.matrix`. **Gensteps run with live-map bookkeeping DEFERRED (~40x cheaper than after `FinalizeInit`).** Harmony skips POSTFIXES when the original throws but always runs FINALIZERS; **a prefix returning false skips the original but POSTFIXES STILL RUN**; prefix and transpiler compose. **`FogGrid` and compressible things are flat per-cell arrays sized by `map.Area`.** **`WaterInfo.GetWaterMovement` indexes `x * map.Size.z + z`.** **TileMutatorDefs compete within a `categories` entry, so a mod can REPLACE a vanilla mutator by declaring its own in the same category.** **`ThingDef.graphic` is baked at PostLoad and never refreshed; `graphicData.Graphic` is lazily rebuilt from CURRENT graphicData - which is why runtime retexture mods work at all (§23).**

---

# 15-19. QOL / WEATHER / SETTINGS / AUDIT / FOREIGN MODLIST
**15a.** Nothing may exist in the void - finders answer inside the surface band; a `GenSpawn.Spawn` prefix rewrites `loc`; a 120-tick sweep catches teleports and pre-fix saves.
**15b.** `CloseToEdge` measured against `map.Size`, so the surface band reported itself as inland everywhere. One prefix re-bases onto the band rect; eleven cold call sites inherit it. **ONE surface-edge finder**; a null dir means "any side, re-rolled" deliberately.
**15d.** Vanilla's no-build edge REMOVED - that strip is also what stops a colony sealing its map edge. **15e.** Drop pods fall through the levels.
**16.** `AB_OpenAir`/`AB_WallTop` set `holdSnowOrSand=false`. Melt per band rewrites the private `outdoorMeltAmount` on EVERY call; **ReGrowth transpiles the same method and composes.** Rejected: swapping `WeatherDef.Worker.overlays`, a global Def. Readout rebuilt from `TryGetTemperatureForCell` - `OutdoorTemp` is NEVER reached because outdoor cells still belong to a Room.
**17.** **⚠ The blank-tab bug:** content height from the previous frame's `CurHeight` is a SELF-SUSTAINING LATCH without a floor. Fix `Mathf.Max(CurHeight + 16f, inner.height)`. **⚠ Draw the diagnostic OUTSIDE the thing being diagnosed.** The unlock gate writes to a LOCAL so the stored value IS the record the warning was read.
**18a.** State taken in a Prefix released in a Postfix - three instances; `ABAimAngle` swaps LIVE COMBAT STATE and opened with `patched = null`, DISCARDING a pending restore. All now `Finalizer`.
**18b.** The mirror: no `ProgramState` guard (~1.3M dead dispatches per 7-band carve), no ascent rule.
**18c.** 12 of 19 kill switches had no call site; the dev spike layout taxed every map in the game.
**18e. CLOSED:** `ABCavernGen.Generate` bails immediately without Biomes! Caverns. **Re-confirmed #231** (0.7/0.0/0.0 ms). The trap: the profile's `mutators: ... Caves` is the VANILLA TILE MUTATOR, unrelated.
**19.** The 910-mod failure was **not us** - the NRE is thrown while EVALUATING ARGUMENTS to `GenerateMap`, so it is never entered. Real cause 24 lines earlier: `startingAndOptionalPawns[startingPawnCount]` with a NEGATIVE count; exactly two mods patch it.

---

# 20. COMPAT LIBRARY
**We load at #900, LAST.** Harmony precedence is by PRIORITY, not load order.

| Family | Certainty | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Grand Rivers / Epic Rivers | 98% | width clamp shipped - **inert under GL** |
| Geological Landforms | 90% | roof fix shipped (untested); rivers TABLED (§22) |

| **Medieval Overhaul golem rocks** | 85% | **already covered (§23)** |

| Alpha Biomes | 50% | presumed Crater-class. No save-path hooks. |

## 20b. SHIPPED (none verified in play)
1. **`Patch_VEE_LoneIsland_ABBandLocal`** - their falloff centres on `map.Center` and both passes walk `map.AllCells` writing elevation 0 + deep ocean below 0.2. On 126x896 the island is a disc of r≈76 at z=448, so **every band except the middle becomes ocean, including the surface**.
2. **`Patch_VEE_Crater_*`** - no single sampling hook, so **wrap the three private noise fields** in `BandLocalModule`. ⚠ Stated cost: one property feeds both axes, so x jitter compresses too.
3. **`Patch_TileMutatorWorker_ABRiverWidth`** - clamps `RiverNode.width` to 22% of band height, at the producer.
4. **`Patch_GL_ABLandformRoofScope` + `Patch_RoofGrid_ABLandformSurfaceOnly`** - GL's roof sweep is ~800k `SetRoof` calls stamping surface roofs onto every band. `[ThreadStatic]` latch released in a Finalizer.

## 20c. CLEARED - do not re-flag without a new confound
ReGrowth wall-snow (vertex range); ReGrowth `Printer_Plane` (linked graphics only); ReGrowth `IsSaveCompressible` + `Mineable.ExposeData` (**`IsSpaceRock()`-gated**); GL `AdjustMineables`; GL priority 800; ReGrowth `DoCellSteadyEffects`/`GetDrawParms`/`GenSpawn.Spawn`; VEE's river family and wildlife mutators.

# 21. ⚠ OPEN: FOG AND ROCKS ON SAVE RELOAD (HELD)
**ELIMINATED:** `ABV2.*` leakage; save compressibility; roof collapse (sky roofs ARE cleared); `RebindAfterLoad` ordering; ReGrowth (space-rock-only); Alpha Biomes / Biomes! (no save-path hooks).
**⚠ THE SYMPTOM PAIR POINTS AT US.** Fog and natural rock are exactly the two things stored as flat per-cell arrays sized by `map.Area`. Everything else - pawns, furniture, **player-built walls** - saves individually.
**Hypotheses:** (a) real data re-generated on load; (b) rendering; (c) per-cell array desync.
**⚠ ONE LOAD, TWO QUESTIONS:** click a reappeared rock (selectable -> data, not -> rendering); check a player-built wall nearby (intact -> (c), disturbed -> (a)). **Did it reproduce on a light modlist?**

# 22. ⚠ TABLED: GL RIVERS
**Tabled at the user's call. NOT resolved - tabled with an unexplained contradiction.**

**Confirmed and still true:** GL REPLACES vanilla river generation. `GL_River`/`GL_RiverConfluence`/etc are `TileMutatorDef`s in the **`River` category** on `TileMutatorWorker_Landform`; mutators compete within a category, so vanilla's worker never runs. **#231 proved it: `riverGraph: 0 node(s)`.** Every river patch we own is therefore **inert** under GL.

**The contradiction to re-read before resuming.** Three observations, no code change between the last two:
1. `surfaceBand=0`, 250x768: river present, `band 0 water=13518`, bands 1-2 zero.
2. A later config: player reported no river anywhere. **UNMEASURED** - the water report never re-fired (count stayed ×1).
3. Later still: "rivers seem to work now." **Also unmeasured.**

**The model that fit 1+2:** GL writes to roughly map rows 0-249 (consistent with `LandformGridSize` defaulting to a square 250 and `MapSpaceToNodeSpaceFactor` entering `GridFunction.Transform<double>` as a UNIFORM scalar). With no basement band 0 IS the surface, so the river shows. With a basement, band 0 is doomed and our `FillRock` overwrites it unconditionally:
```csharp
terrain.SetTerrain(c, rock.building?.naturalTerrain ?? TerrainDefOf.Gravel);
```
Our carve is a POSTFIX on `GenerateContentsIntoMap`, so it runs AFTER GL's mutators. **Two locally-correct behaviours; the bug is the ORDER.**

**Observation 3 does not fit that model**, and nothing changed in code, so the variable is environmental (tile, plan shape, or GL settings) and was never captured. **Resuming requires measured readings with the water report, on a map, with the count checked.**

**⚠ FALSIFIABLE PREDICTION, still unrun:** `TransformIntoMapSpace` is the funnel for EVERY landform output (elevation, fertility, caves, terrain, biome grid). If the model holds, a `GL_Canyon`/`GL_Crater` tile with a basement generates as a *plain* map. If landform shaping DOES appear, the model is dead.
**Fix surface if resumed:** `TransformIntoMapSpace` is the one funnel but returns `IGridFunction<T>`, a foreign generic interface - unlike `ModuleBase` it cannot be subclassed without referencing their assembly. `GeologicalLandformsAPI.LandformGridSize` is published but sets RESOLUTION, not placement. **Worth contacting the GL author.**
**CLOSED red herring:** GL's `ApplyWaterFlow` indexes `i * map.Size.z + j`, matching vanilla's `GetWaterMovement`. Not a bug.

# 23. RENDERER COMPAT: RETEXTURE AND FORMATION MODS

## 23a. ⚠ BETTER MOUNTAINS IS ALREADY FULLY SUPPORTED - DO NOT REBUILD IT
`ChaoticEnrico.BetterMountains`. Its `TextureApplier` rewrites `rockDef.graphicData` wholesale at startup **and again whenever its mod settings change**, swapping to `graphicClass = Graphic_Random`, `drawSize 2x2`, `CutoutComplex`, plus recolouring Chunk/Blocks/Smoothed defs and `Tile*`/`Flagstone*`/`*_Rough` TerrainDefs. It also carries its own compat keys for Alpha Biomes, Biomes! Islands, MO (`DankPyon_NaturalWall_Clay`) and CCP stone.

Our renderer already handles all of it, and the rationale is recorded against numbered runs:
- **`SectionLayer_ABMountainCap.LiveGraphicFor`** reads `graphicData.Graphic` (lazily rebuilt from CURRENT data), **never the baked `def.graphic` field** - which is fixed at PostLoad. Run #53's probe found `Graphic_LinkedCornerFiller` on a BM-swapped Granite, so the stale field rendered vanilla atlas while the surrounding walls rendered BM art.
- **`AtlasBaseFor` / `VariantsFor`** cache per def but **validate the cached entry against the live graphic**, so a mid-game BM settings apply invalidates them. `VariantsFor` exists specifically for `Graphic_Random`, with `StableCellIndex` picking a deterministic per-cell variant.
- **`ABMinedRockLookup.TryGetMinedRockColor`** reads the tint live for the same reason.
- **`ABDepthView.CanShrink`** excludes rock by `mineable || isNaturalRock` **by DEF rather than by link type**, precisely because BM makes rock non-linked (V1 run #50).

**Lesson recorded in §14:** grep the mod's name in our own source before building compat for it.

## 23b. MEDIEVAL OVERHAUL "STRANGE FORMATIONS" - ALREADY COVERED
The user-facing name maps to `DankPyon_GolemRock_{Iron,Silver,Gold,Steel}[_MapGen|_Incident]`, labelled *"unusual iron formation"* etc. Shape:
`thingClass MedievalOverhaul.Mineable_CompSpawnerDestroy`, `size (2,2)`, `graphicClass Graphic_Random`, `drawSize 4,4` (2x overdraw), `mineable true`, `building.isNaturalRock true`, `saveCompressible true`, `castEdgeShadows`, `holdsRoof`, `blockLight`.

Every one of those lands on an existing path:
- `mineable` AND `isNaturalRock` are BOTH true, so `CanShrink` returns false on either clause - excluded from the depth shrink like all natural rock, which is correct (a 4x4 sprite shrunk per level would swim against the rock around it).
- `size (2,2)` is handled by **`IsPrintAnchor`**, which walks `OccupiedRect` and prints once at the first cell that shows below - so it does not print four times.
- `Graphic_Random` is the MountainCap's `VariantsFor` path (built for BM, generalises for free).
- `castEdgeShadows` feeds the existing `BelowEdgeShadows` mirror.
**Prediction if untrue:** the visible failure would be a 2x2 formation drawn four times overlapping, or drawn at full size among shrunken neighbours. Neither has been reported.

## 23c. ⚠ BETTER TREES IS THE REAL GAP
`ChaoticEnrico.BetterTrees` ships `TextureAndSizeApplier` (retexture like BM) **plus two systems BM has no analogue for**:
- **`TreeScaleDef` / `TreeScaleTemplateDef` / `TreeScaleSetting`** - runtime rescaling of tree `drawSize`. Probably composes with the depth shrink (both multiply about `TrueCenter`), and trees are NOT excluded by `CanShrink` (not mineable, not natural rock, not linked). Unverified.
- **`TransparencyController` / `TransparencyMapComponent` / `Plant_Graphic_TransparencyPatch` / `Plant_SnowGraphic_TransparencyPatch`** - a keybound toggle that makes tree canopies transparent so the player can see under them. **This is the suspicious one.** It patches `Plant.Graphic`, which our below view reaches through `t.Print(this)`, so below-level trees inherit whatever transparency state the controller decides. If that decision is per-map or camera-derived rather than per-band, the below view could get canopy transparency that disagrees with the level being viewed.
- `Plant_SnowGraphic_TransparencyPatch` additionally touches the plant snow graphic, which interacts with the unverified below-snow mirror (§6f).

**NOT YET INVESTIGATED and no symptom reported.** Do not build until a symptom is named - see §14 on configuration and on checking whether it is already built.
